add_executable(AudioProcessorTest source/AudioProcessorTest.cpp)

# Setup references to JucePlugin generated by juce_add_plugin in /plugin/CMakeLists.txt
target_compile_definitions(
  AudioProcessorTest
  PRIVATE JucePlugin_Name="MyPlugin"
          JucePlugin_ManufacturerCode=Adbm
          JucePlugin_Code=Demo
          JucePlugin_IsSynth=0
          JucePlugin_WantsMidiInput=0
          JucePlugin_ProducesMidiOutput=0
          JucePlugin_IsMidiEffect=0
)

target_sources(AudioProcessorTest PRIVATE ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/plugin/source/PluginProcessor.cpp)

find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)

# These 2 packages have to be included manually. JUCE fails to resolve this internally when loading juce_gui_extra
pkg_check_modules(GTK REQUIRED gtk+-3.0)
pkg_check_modules(WEBKIT REQUIRED webkit2gtk-4.1)

target_include_directories(
  AudioProcessorTest PRIVATE ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/plugin/include ${GTK_INCLUDE_DIRS} ${WEBKIT_INCLUDE_DIRS}
)

target_link_libraries(
  AudioProcessorTest
  PRIVATE juce::juce_recommended_config_flags
          juce::juce_audio_processors
          juce::juce_gui_extra # forces GTK include to resolve
          ${GTK_LIBRARIES}
          ${WEBKIT_LIBRARIES}
          curl
)

add_definitions(${GTK_CFLAGS_OTHER})

set_target_properties(AudioProcessorTest PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/test)
